message.content: {"note_claim": "VAR can review yellow cards issued due to mistaken identity, as happened in USA vs Paraguay when Tim Ream's booking was overturned and given to Miguel Almirón for simulation.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Makkelie eventually overturned the yellow on Ream, instead booking Almirón for simulation, justifying the “mistaken identity” definition.", "reason": "The Guardian article directly describes the IFAB rule allowing VAR review of yellow cards for mistaken identity and the Ream/Almirón incident in USA vs Paraguay."}

parsed.note_claim: VAR can review yellow cards issued due to mistaken identity, as happened in USA vs Paraguay when Tim Ream's booking was overturned and given to Miguel Almirón for simulation.
